judge.first_pass.node.why: the full judge backend is not recorded on harvest rows; the label is the deterministic git verification, so there is no paired incumbent answer to compare against

judge.first_pass.tool.why: same join as the permission rows: the human's decision labels the call; no incumbent decider answer is recorded

dec.classify_error.why: the deterministic S0 diagnostic is the incumbent decider and is logged as x-incumbent on every row (it is also the labeler, so the incumbent error rate is 0 by construction)

vendor.consequential.why: the caller's own consequential flag is logged as x-incumbent; the bank is tighten-only and its name keeps it in the never-auto-act class (permission/money/client family)

memory.route.why: the incumbent recall always searches the fixed facts+entities+observations union; it never picks one of the ROUTE options, so there is no comparable answer (its set is kept in memory_s1_decisions.incumbent_label)

memory.relation.why: the incumbent LLM op answers only some candidates (untouched candidates get the weak 'unrelated' label, source memory.incumbent.untouched); rows without an incumbent answer are skipped in non-inferiority

*_target.why: the planner's executed target (matched to an element index) is sent for the executed operation's <op>_target question only; the speculative targets of operations it did not choose have no incumbent answer

stuck.why: the planner never answers 'stuck'; the loop's only stall check ends the run before the shadow head runs
